verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs list checks among its payment capabilities for sending and receiving money, which loosely covers check issuance and check receipt. No evidence describes how either works, so the depth of the capability is unproven. missing for 10: documented check-issuance API endpoints, check deposit flow with front/back image capture, check-deposit status or clearing details, sandbox simulation for checks, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments
